retailEvidence.method: pefile and Capstone over the retail executables and the 1.01 game library; addresses are virtual addresses; no retail code is incorporated

SV_Map_f.spPrefix: Q_stricmpn(cmd, "sp", 2) at 0x45616a; g_gametype 5.0 (0x40a00000) at 0x45617f; g_doWarmup 0; sv_maxclients latched "8" (0x45619a); cheats off, bots killed
SV_Map_f.otherwise: devmap or spdevmap: cheats and bots killed; no game type is changed

SVC_Info.gate: returns while ui_singlePlayerActive != 0.0 (0x45fa18..0x45fa3c); g_gametype is not read for it
SVC_Info.gametypePointer: 0xb93474, read for the gametype key (0x45fb35) and to pick g_duelWeaponDisable for 3 and 4 (0x45fbaa)

jampgamex86_dll_1_01.refused: g_gametype 1, 2 and 9 print "This gametype is not supported." and set g_gametype "0" (0x2008ea5b..0x2008eace); out of range prints "g_gametype %i is out of range, defaulting to 0"
jampgamex86_dll_1_01.arenas: 23 entries in assets0.pk3 scripts/*.arena: ffa team, duel powerduel, ctf team, siege; none lists jedimaster or holocron

SV_Map_f.spPrefix: g_gametype 4.0 (0x40800000) at 0x4479c0; g_doWarmup 0; sv_maxclients latched "8"; cheats off, bots killed
SV_Map_f.otherwise: devmap or spdevmap: cheats and bots killed; then g_gametype 0 when sv_gametype is 4 (0x447a2c..0x447a43)
